name: com.coffeebean.excel
description: Editor-only config-table toolchain for the CoffeeBean framework: Excel reading (MiniExcel) with header detection and aliases, type inference, and generation of JSON + C# data classes + getters. Editor-only, no runtime code; optionally integrated with com.coffeebean.core for module discovery and version checks.

samples.description: Excel 工具演示：样例配置表 + 生成 JSON/C# 数据类/Getter 的完整流程。
